title: Light Party — St James's Church, Harvington
body: Celebrate the light in darkness with games, music, activities, food and drink, 4–6pm. Dress code: colourful or sparkly. Free, with donations welcome; book a place at eventssjch@outlook.com. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

image.alt: “Light Party, Sat 31 Oct, 4–6pm, free, St James's Church, Harvington” over rows of glowing paper lanterns at night
